verified_facts.text: De L'Europe first opened its doors as Hotel De L'Europe on 23 September 1896.
verified_facts.excerpt: On September 23rd of 1896 , the building first opened its doors as Hotel De L’Europe.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands exactly where a 1482 city defence tower called Het Rondeel once stood.
verified_facts.excerpt: named one of its main towers ‘Het Rondeel’. This stood exactly where De L’Europe Amsterdam stands today.

verified_facts.text: In the 1950s Alfred 'Freddy' Heineken bought the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: He eventually decided to buy the hotel making De L’Europe the first and only family-owned luxury hotel in Amsterdam.

verified_facts.text: Today the hotel is owned by the HEINEKEN company.
verified_facts.excerpt: Today the hotel is proudly owned by the HEINEKEN company.

verified_facts.text: In 2020 Dutch interior designers Nicemakers restyled the rooms, public areas, event rooms, three restaurants and the bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2020 De L’Europe went through a complete redesign, bringing in all modern luxuries while still honouring the rich history. Dutch-based interior designers ‘Nicemakers’ were responsible for the restyling

verified_facts.text: The 't Huys wing has suites each designed by a local Amsterdam partner brand, with experiences tied to that partner.
verified_facts.excerpt: They’re all designed by local partners, so every suite is a unique world of its own. Plus, each suite comes with experiences that really take you into the world of the local partner.

verified_facts.text: 't Huys is an old spelling of het huis, meaning the house in Dutch.
verified_facts.excerpt: ‘T HUYS IS AN OLD SPELLING OF HET HUIS, MEANING THE HOUSE IN DUTCH

verified_facts.text: The Royal Penthouse Suite has a private terrace with Amstel river views and was designed by Dutch studio Nicemakers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned Dutch design studio Nicemakers, the Royal Penthouse Suite starts with one spacious bedroom with baldaquin king size bed and can be extended to five bedrooms.

verified_facts.text: Freddy's Bar is named after Alfred 'Freddy' Heineken, who used to relax there.
verified_facts.excerpt: A gentleman’s pub named after Alfred “Freddy” Heineken – who used to repose here.

verified_facts.text: Freddy's Bar hosts live jazz and works on a walk-in basis without reservations.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is the place in Amsterdam where both locals and visitors come to socialize, connect and enjoy live jazz. Freddy’s Bar operates on a walk-in basis

verified_facts.text: The hotel's restaurants include Restaurant Flore, Brasserie Marie and Trattoria Graziella.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three of the city's finest restaurants under one roof: Michelin-starred Restaurant Flore, Brasserie Marie, and Trattoria Graziella.

verified_facts.text: The weekend afternoon tea overlooks the Amstel River and moves to the terrace in good weather.
verified_facts.excerpt: During warmer days and good weather, this refined high tea experience is served on our terrace, allowing you to enjoy the elegant surroundings and riverside views in the open air.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served on Saturday and Sunday afternoons.
verified_facts.excerpt: SERVED SATURDAY & SUNDAY AFTERNOON

verified_facts.text: The afternoon tea cannot offer lactose-free or gluten-free options.
verified_facts.excerpt: we are unable to offer lactose-free or gluten-free options for our Afternoon Tea

verified_facts.text: The spa has a heated indoor pool, saunas, relaxation areas and a fitness studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: including the heated indoor pool, saunas, relaxation areas and fitness studio

verified_facts.text: Overnight guests get complimentary access to the spa and wellness facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overnight guests of De L’Europe enjoy complimentary access to the spa and wellness facilities throughout their stay.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Biologique Recherche facial treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to bring **Biologique Recherche** to Amsterdam

verified_facts.text: Concept store IN-HUYS on the ground floor of 't Huys sells items by local designers, and purchases can be charged to the room.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can conveniently add your In-Huys Concept Store purchases to your room services bill

verified_facts.text: The Wunderkammer atelier in 't Huys shows floral art, interior objects and curiosities by floral artists Florian Seyd and Ueli Signer.
verified_facts.excerpt: renowned floral artists and co-founders, Florian Seyd and Ueli Signer, display floral works of art, interior objects and curiosities

verified_facts.text: The One-Bedroom Prestige Apartment has a fully equipped kitchen and suits longer stays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfect for longer visits, this apartment features a fully equipped kitchen

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits where the Amstel River meets the Rokin canal.
verified_facts.excerpt: looms large at the crossroads of the Amstel River and Rokin canal

verified_facts.text: There is no kids club, but rooms from the premium deluxe category can interconnect.
verified_facts.excerpt: No kids club or specific family experiences, but rooms from the premium deluxe category can interconnect.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is wheelchair friendly with four elevators, including spa access.
verified_facts.excerpt: De L'Europe Amsterdam is wheelchair friendly. The hotel has four elevators, including access to the spa

verified_facts.text: The hotel's art includes the Heineken family's Dutch art collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: who have furnished its walls with their impressive Dutch art collection
